categories.main_business_segments: Puyang Huicheng Electronic Material Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, production, and sales of fine chemical products, focusing on maleic anhydride derivatives and functional material intermediates. Its products are widely applied in electronic component packaging materials, electrical insulation materials, wind power, composite materials, coatings, and organic optoelectronic materials. The company also develops new materials technology and provides related technical services and import-export business.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes mature batch production technologies for maleic anhydride derivatives and functional material intermediates, supported by a strong in-house R&D team. It holds over 100 patents, including invention and utility model patents, and emphasizes continuous process optimization, cost reduction, and product quality improvement. The company employs advanced quality control systems such as SPC and DCS, and has established electronic-grade quality standards aligned with international norms.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include international well-known companies such as Huntsman, Westlake, and OLED material manufacturers. The company serves industries like electronics, electrical equipment, coatings, composite materials, and organic optoelectronics. Its products cater to both domestic and overseas markets, with domestic sales accounting for approximately 67% and international sales about 33% of total revenue.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production facilities in Puyang Economic and Technological Development Zone, Heze Economic Development Zone, and Zhangzhou Gulei Port Economic Development Zone. It actively expands overseas markets, contributing to about one-third of its revenue. The company also has subsidiaries in Henan, Shandong, Fujian, and other provinces, supporting its nationwide and international presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: Puyang Huicheng operates primarily in the midstream segment of the chemical supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing of fine chemical intermediates and derivatives. It sources raw materials such as maleic anhydride and other chemical feedstocks, processes them into specialized chemical products, and supplies these to downstream industries including electronics, coatings, and composites.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation and R&D investment, focusing on enhancing production processes, developing new high-value products, and expanding product lines in OLED functional materials and other advanced chemical intermediates. It leverages its R&D platforms and collaborates with universities and research institutes to strengthen core competencies. The strategic plan includes capacity expansion, talent development, market diversification, and sustainability initiatives aligned with national policies on carbon neutrality.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of chemical products, including maleic anhydride derivatives and functional material intermediates. The company uses a direct sales model with pricing based on raw material costs, market demand, and customer negotiations. It also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns, but product sales constitute the main revenue source.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: As a leading domestic producer of maleic anhydride derivatives and fine chemical intermediates, Puyang Huicheng holds a strong market position with advantages in scale, technology, and cost. It competes with smaller domestic producers and international suppliers, leveraging faster market response and stable customer relationships. The company aims to consolidate its leadership in the domestic market and expand its influence in the OLED materials sector.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.41 billion, representing a 2.31% increase over the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 191.55 million, a decline of 18.53% year-over-year. The company maintains substantial total assets of around RMB 2.81 billion and net assets of RMB 2.41 billion. Despite profit pressure from market conditions, the company shows steady revenue growth and ongoing investment in capacity and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Puyang Huicheng emphasizes technological leadership, cost advantages, and continuous product line optimization to provide high-quality, high-value fine chemical products. It differentiates itself through strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, flexible production systems, and rigorous quality control aligned with international standards. The company’s ability to rapidly respond to customer needs and maintain stable, trusted relationships with global clients enhances its competitive edge.
